name: CI pipeline assessment
problem_statement: Deploy failures have roughly doubled since the platform migration, and nobody can say which pipelines are responsible.

deliverables.name: Pipeline assessment
deliverables.acceptance: covers all seven named pipelines against the six criteria in Appendix A

deliverables.name: Prioritised remediation sequence
deliverables.acceptance: every finding in D1 appears exactly once, ranked, with an effort estimate

assumptions: read access to the CI system is granted in week 1
the seven pipelines in scope are those listed in Appendix A and do not change
exclusions: on-call or incident support during the engagement

client_inputs.input: read access to the CI system and build history
client_inputs.if_late: the clock continues; the end date moves day for day

client_inputs.input: 90 minutes with each of the three platform engineers
client_inputs.if_late: findings are marked unverified in the report

change_procedure: Work outside the deliverables above is a change order, quoted and agreed in writing before it starts.

contract.termination_compensation: work performed to date plus committed third-party costs
contract.transition_assistance: at standard rates, capped at 10 days
